description: The customised Statistics Canada product presents four input-output scenarios: current coal and natural-gas consumption, coal only, gas only, and gas consumption including replacement of coal. The stated geography includes Canada, provinces and Alberta for 2010. A ZIP distribution is listed, but its internal file formats and whether it contains executable model software are unstated. This record represents the documented scenario information. It does not infer a runnable optimisation model, replacement efficiency, emissions factors or scenario results absent from the metadata. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
